components.description: Receives OTLP data from the managed ingestion path.
Add, change and remove fields on records.

options.label: Resource
options.description: Fields of the resource that produced the telemetry, such as the service name.

options.label: Scope
options.description: Fields of the instrumentation scope (the library) that produced the telemetry.

options.label: Log
options.description: Fields of a log record, such as its body, severity and attributes.

options.label: Span
options.description: Fields of a trace span, such as its name, status and attributes.

options.label: Span event
options.description: Fields of an event recorded on a span, such as an exception.

options.label: Metric
options.description: Fields of a metric, such as its name, unit and type.

options.label: Data point
options.description: Fields of a metric data point, such as its value and attributes.

options.label: Exemplar
options.description: Fields of an exemplar, a sample trace attached to a metric data point.

options.label: Profile
options.description: Fields of a profile, such as its duration and sampling period.

options.description: Batch-level metadata that travels with the data through the pipeline. It is not sent to the destination with each record.

definitions.description: Add, change and remove fields on records.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: Portable base location of the path. Omit it to write a full OTTL path.

fields.name: context
fields.label: Context
fields.description: Explicit OTTL context of the path. Not used together with location.

fields.name: path
fields.label: Path
fields.description: Field path within the location, or a full OTTL path when no location is set.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: Literal value to write. Mutually exclusive with ottl_value.

fields.name: ottl_value
fields.label: OTTL value
fields.description: OTTL expression evaluated in the applicable context. Mutually exclusive with value.

options.label: Upsert
options.description: Write unconditionally.

options.label: Update
options.description: Write only when the field already exists.

options.label: Insert
options.description: Write only when the field is absent.

options.label: Delete
options.description: Remove the field. No value is used.

help.summary: Add, change and remove fields on records.

definitions.description: Writes records to one fixed Elasticsearch index or data stream.

fields.name: index
fields.label: Index
fields.description: The index or data stream every record is written to. It must be a fixed, lowercase name with no wildcards, templates or date math.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.description: An Elasticsearch API key, for testing. Without it the key comes from the environment.

help.summary: Writes records to one fixed Elasticsearch index or data stream.
